patterns.note: The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections are presented with generous vertical spacing, using a full-width hero and footer, while main content is constrained to a central column.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif typeface, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and often uppercase, fine-print labels.
A stark monochrome palette of black and white dominates, with subtle light grey used for background variations and borders.
The hero section features a large, solid black geometric triangle as a central, abstract visual element, contrasting with the minimalist text.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header by positioning the navigation bar fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring it overlays content as the user scrolls.
Achieve a high-contrast, minimalist aesthetic by primarily using black for text and interactive elements against a white or very light grey background.
Structure content in distinct, well-separated sections, with a clear visual hierarchy established through varying font sizes and weights, and ample vertical padding.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels. Body text is legible and clean.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal to no visible border-radius on most elements, except for subtle rounding on buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and clarity.

standout: The design's standout feature is its extreme minimalism and high-contrast aesthetic, anchored by a single, stark black geometric triangle in the hero. This creates a powerful, almost architectural visual identity that feels both modern and authoritative.
